title: deploymentCommand
responsibility: Runs a bounded deployment subprocess without a shell or inherited Cloudflare credentials; returns stdout.

inputs.name: deploymentCommand.command
inputs.description: One deployment step: args[0] is the executable, args.slice(1) are its arguments (run directly, with no shell), and cwd is the working directory. The optional env field is merged over the cliEnvironment() base, then CI is always forced to 'true', so an env entry can never override CI.

outputs.name: deploymentCommand
outputs.description: Resolves with the child's stdout once it closes with code 0; only the last 1,000,000 characters are kept and stderr is discarded. It rejects when the child cannot start or closes with a non-zero or null code, and because the 20-minute timer only calls killOwnedProcess on the child, a timed-out step rejects only if it then closes with a non-zero or null code.
examples:
Checked 214 files. No problems found.
Uploaded 12 files
Deployment complete: https://4f2c9a1e.acme-site.pages.dev

errors.name: DeploymentCommandError
errors.description: Rejects with new DeploymentCommandError('Deployment command could not start.') when the child process emits an 'error' event, which the code treats as a failure to start.

errors.name: Deployment command exited unsuccessfully
errors.description: Rejects with new Error('Deployment step <first three args joined by spaces> failed (<code>).') when the child closes with any code other than 0, including null; stderr is never part of the message.
